analytics.name: Analytic 1891
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process with both a listening socket on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port and an outbound connection to a non-ICS destination, or iptables DNAT/REDIRECT rules added on ICS protocol ports. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

tuning.description: Time window and byte-count proportionality tolerance used to determine whether concurrent flows represent a relay pattern.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; command line invokes iptables/nftables to change ICS traffic filtering or redirection outside the authorized network-administration baseline

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): bind/listen/connect syscalls show one process accepting ICS-protocol connections while also initiating an outbound connection to a non-ICS destination

OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
